comments.author: bryanlarsen
comments.story: New Glenn’s Progress Towards Maiden Flight
comments.why: SpaceX's scrapped Falcon 9 second stage reuse mockup
comments.text: I feel fairly certain that Blue Origin has plans for second stage reuse. Whether these plans have gone much past the napkin phase is another question. SpaceX mocked up a plan to reuse the second stage of Falcon 9. [VIDEO] These plans were scrapped to concentrate on Starship. If the Falcon 9 is big enough to have enough margin to support second stage reuse, New Glenn definitely does too.

comments.author: zardo
comments.story: SpaceX Falcon rocket explodes on landing after delivering satellite to space
comments.text: It certainly was at the start. [VIDEO] Apparently they are no longer pursuing stage 2 reuse on the Falcon 9. The next gen superheavy lift rocket, the BFR, is intended to be fully reusable though.
